title: The supported diagonal unit and the two trace triangles
statement: Assume the coefficient, normalized twist and Kummer conventions of [lem-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-maps]. Suppose given for every Noetherian base a splitting whose hom is the specified Kummer two-component map, and suppose these maps satisfy the decomposition square. Let epsilon be the actual natural inverse-projection trace counit of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-trace-counit]. There is a natural transformation eta:id→q^*Rq_*(-) tensor A_P(1)[2] satisfying both component triangular equations with epsilon on all complexes. Moreover epsilon satisfies its canonical ordinary-etale exchange and right-functor base-change square. No existence or invertibility of a decomposition is concluded here.

proof.text: Construct the supported diagonal unit and prove the first and second triangular equations from the two normalized diagonal integrals and the coordinate contraction identities. Transport the coefficient line to the prescribed ordinaryFiniteP1Right.

Invert the specified Kummer biproduct square and compose with its second projection. Tensor this scalar trace square with the arbitrary complex and use the canonical inverse-projection base-change equation.

lean.statement: theorem ordinaryFiniteP1_diagonal_unit (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0) (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA) (c : OrdinaryFiniteP1ChernFamily A N hA) (hc : OrdinaryFiniteP1ChernFamilySpec A N hA c) (b : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))), ((ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA S)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧ ⊞ ordinaryFiniteUnit A S) ≅ (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).obj ((ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)) (hb : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))), (b S hS).hom = ordinaryFiniteP1KummerMap A N hA t c S hS) (hbc : OrdinaryFiniteP1KummerMapBaseChange A N hA t c) : (∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))), ∃ η : 𝟭 (DerivedCategoryModule A (ProjectiveLine S)) ⟶ ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) ⋙ ordinaryFiniteP1Right A N hA S, (∀ M : DerivedCategoryModule A (ProjectiveLine S), (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).map (η.app M) ≫ (ordinaryFiniteP1TraceCounit A N hA S (b S hS)).app ((ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).obj M) = 𝟙 _) ∧ (∀ K : DerivedCategoryModule A S, η.app ((ordinaryFiniteP1Right A N hA S).obj K) ≫ (ordinaryFiniteP1Right A N hA S).map ((ordinaryFiniteP1TraceCounit A N hA S (b S hS)).app K) = 𝟙 _)) ∧ (∀ {S' S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S'] [IsNoetherian S] (f : S' ⟶ S) (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (hS' : IsUnit (N : Γ(S', ⊤))) (K : DerivedCategoryModule A S), (ordinaryFinitePullback A f).map ((ordinaryFiniteP1TraceCounit A N hA S (b S hS)).app K) = ordinaryFiniteP1Exchange A f ((ordinaryFiniteP1Right A N hA S).obj K) ≫ (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S' ↘ S')).map (ordinaryFiniteP1RightBaseChange A N hA t f (ordinaryFiniteP1_isUnit N S hS) K).hom ≫ (ordinaryFiniteP1TraceCounit A N hA S' (b S' hS')).app ((ordinaryFinitePullback A f).obj K))
